We post a new video every day to help you learn English free. Our videos cover a range of topics, including vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, listening, and speaking skills. 
Additionally, extra videos are published throughout the week, so make sure to visit the channel daily to see what's new. Your comments are appreciated and read with pleasure, but kindly use English when commenting. 
For more English-learning videos and content, visit https://youtube.com/@ABCLearningEnglish.
